config.reliable_requiem.title: Reliable Requiem Configuration
config.reliable_requiem.enabled.tooltip: Toggles whether all Reliable Requiem features are active.
config.reliable_requiem.keepFood.tooltip: If enabled, players will retain their food level upon respawning instead of resetting to 20.
config.reliable_requiem.keepSaturation.t: If enabled, players will retain their saturation level upon respawning.
config.reliable_requiem.minFood.tooltip: The absolute minimum food level a player will have after respawning.
config.reliable_requiem.maxFood.tooltip: The absolute maximum food level a player can have after respawning.
config.reliable_requiem.lostXpPercent.to: The percentage of total experience points permanently lost upon death (1.0 = 100% lost, 0.0 = 0% lost).
config.reliable_requiem.droppedXpPerLeve: The amount of XP dropped on the ground per experience level the player had.
config.reliable_requiem.maxDroppedXp.too: The maximum total amount of XP that can be dropped on the ground upon death.
config.reliable_requiem.keepMainInventor: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to keep each individual item in the main inventory.
config.reliable_requiem.keepHotbarChance: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to keep each individual item in the hotbar.
Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to keep each equipped armor piece.
config.reliable_requiem.keepOffhandChanc: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to keep the item currently held in the offhand.
config.reliable_requiem.keepDurabilityLo: Percentage of max durability lost (0.0 to 1.0) when an item is successfully kept on death.
config.reliable_requiem.defaultDestroyCh: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) that an item meant to be dropped is entirely destroyed instead.
How long in seconds dropped items stay on the ground before despawning.
config.reliable_requiem.neverDespawnDeat: If enabled, items dropped on death will never naturally despawn, ignoring the standard despawn timer.
config.reliable_requiem.condenseDeathDro: If enabled, items and experience dropped on death will drop directly onto your corpse instead of splattering outward.
config.reliable_requiem.explosionResista: If enabled, items dropped on death cannot be destroyed by explosions like creepers or TNT.
config.reliable_requiem.keptItemOverride: List of item IDs (e.g., minecraft:diamond) that will ALWAYS be kept on death.
config.reliable_requiem.droppedItemOverr: List of item IDs that will ALWAYS be dropped on death, bypassing keep chances.
config.reliable_requiem.destroyedItemOve: List of item IDs that will ALWAYS be destroyed on death.
config.reliable_requiem.bypassKeepInvent: List of dimension IDs (e.g., minecraft:the_nether) where all keep inventory rules are disabled.
config.reliable_requiem.bypassDamageSour: List of damage source IDs that will bypass keep inventory rules (e.g., lava, outOfWorld).
config.reliable_requiem.scaleRespawnHeal: If enabled, respawn health will be calculated as a percentage of the player's maximum health.
config.reliable_requiem.respawnHealthPer: Percentage (0.1 to 1.0) of maximum health the player will respawn with if scaling is enabled.
config.reliable_requiem.maxRespawnHealth: The absolute maximum amount of health a player can respawn with.
config.reliable_requiem.respawnRandomRad: Radius in blocks to randomly offset the player's respawn position. Set to 0 to disable.
config.reliable_requiem.keepPositiveEffe: If enabled, players will retain beneficial potion effects after respawning.
config.reliable_requiem.keepNegativeEffe: If enabled, players will retain harmful potion effects after respawning.
config.reliable_requiem.applyMementoMori: If enabled, players are afflicted with the Memento Mori debuff upon respawning.
How long the Memento Mori effect lasts in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.reliable_requiem.mementoSpeedModi: Movement speed multiplier applied by Memento Mori (negative values slow the player down).
config.reliable_requiem.mementoDamageMod: Flat attack damage modifier applied by Memento Mori (negative values reduce damage).
config.reliable_requiem.displayDeathCoor: Shows your X, Y, and Z coordinates on the death screen.
config.reliable_requiem.restrictRespawni: If enabled, players will always spawn at the world spawn, ignoring beds and respawn anchors.
